package main

// 取り出し方の幅を見る合成の仕込み: 座標が (行, 列) の順、スタートが配列、地図は初期化子と init() で組む。
// 面 1 は届く（扉が道を塞いでいる）。面 2 はカギが扉の向こうにあり、扉を閉じたままではカギに届かない。

const (
	H = 6
	W = 7
)

const (
	Floor = iota
	Wall
	Door
)

var stages [2][H][W]int

var startPos = [2][2]int{{1, 1}, {1, 1}} // (行, 列)
var keyPos = [2][2]int{{1, 5}, {4, 1}}
var doorPos = [2][2]int{{3, 3}, {3, 3}}
var goalPos = [2][2]int{{4, 5}, {4, 5}}

func init() {
	for s := range stages {
		for r := 0; r < H; r++ {
			for c := 0; c < W; c++ {
				if r == 0 || r == H-1 || c == 0 || c == W-1 {
					stages[s][r][c] = Wall
				}
			}
		}
		// 3 行目に横の壁。扉の 1 マスだけが隙間。
		for c := 1; c < W-1; c++ {
			stages[s][3][c] = Wall
		}
		stages[s][doorPos[s][0]][doorPos[s][1]] = Door
		stages[s][startPos[s][0]][startPos[s][1]] = Floor
		stages[s][keyPos[s][0]][keyPos[s][1]] = Floor
		stages[s][goalPos[s][0]][goalPos[s][1]] = Floor
	}
}

type Game struct{ stage, row, col int }

func (g *Game) at(r, c int) int { return stages[g.stage][r][c] }

func (g *Game) reset() {
	g.row = startPos[g.stage][0]
	g.col = startPos[g.stage][1]
	_ = g.at(keyPos[g.stage][0], keyPos[g.stage][1])
	_ = g.at(goalPos[g.stage][0], goalPos[g.stage][1])
}

func main() {}
